canonicalAudit.finding: Before CD-02, public CanonicalFrameV1::new/push_bytes/push_string/fingerprint allowed caller bytes to be directly framed and hashed with no semantic allow-list.
canonicalAudit.correction: CanonicalFrameV1 and CanonicalFieldTagV1 are crate-private and no longer re-exported. FingerprintDomainV1 remains public because it is part of public ContinuationFrameV1 and CanonicalEventV1 values, but it cannot construct/hash a frame. A public compile-fail doctest proves CanonicalFrameV1 cannot be imported.
canonicalAudit.goldenCoverage: Golden request bytes and digest, repeated semantic-frame byte invariance, domain separation, ascending stable tags/domains, field-order rejection, and fixed-width/length-prefixed primitive encoding are covered in crate unit tests.
canonicalAudit.publicFingerprintValue: CanonicalFingerprint::new validates the external 64-character lowercase-hex value shape; it does not hash caller byte slices. Public JSON round-trip remains covered.
canonicalAudit.futureBoundary: Semantic request/event/journal fingerprint builders are not yet implemented in Pack A. Any later public builder must encode a typed allow-listed semantic projection and exclude diagnostics, timestamps, locale-dependent values, and secret-bearing data.
canonicalAudit.reviewResult: The generic raw frame hash path is no longer exposed by the current public API; remaining internal primitive is explicitly reserved for future typed allow-listed builders.
